description.zh: 最后开 Exporting as Code。运行时链接就是证明。 Spline, Inc. 的浏览器 3D 设计工具，可把场景导出到 Web、iOS 与 Android。编辑器免费档带水印；@splinetool/react-spline 为 MIT，运行时包未标 SPDX。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Spline (https://spline.design/).
Technology stack: javascript, webgl, react, three-js.
Component specification: 最后开 Exporting as Code。运行时链接就是证明。

Visual details from source observation: 我们进首页，标题 Make anything 3D，中间是 AI 输入框。文档写它是网页端 3D 设计工具，可发到 web 与 iOS。Exporting as Code 列出 Vanilla JS 运行时和 React 包装。编辑器专有；react-spline 为 MIT；运行时 npm 包未标 license。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
